title: Expose theme determinism checking as a prez capability (deferred)
objective: DEFERRED, not blocking the hoist. A consumer with a GENERATED theme (the estate's brand, built from tokens.yaml) needs to re-check determinism on every regeneration, and today's drift check proves the CSS matches the tokens without proving the result is deterministic. The estate must NOT copy the probe -- two homes for one check is the drift this thread exists to remove -- and must not reach into prez's internal test/ directory, which is the coupling the hoist removed. Split by what each side actually needs: the ESTATE's risk is static (did regeneration put a preference query into the CSS?) and is answerable by a grep on the generated file alone, with no CCD, no Node and no dependency on prez internals -- that goes in _tools' cutover commit and is _tools-cc's. The RUNTIME question (does the computed palette agree under emulated light and dark) is the tool's, and prez should expose it as a first-class verb rather than as a test file. Scope, sequencing and the verb's name are open; mint ACs when it is picked up.
